content:
✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Interesting visual puzzle that can be solved multiple ways. Good for building reasoning and string manipulation skills :)
Please add some test cases where some fish are swimming directly to the right of either the line (i.e. "|>=X") or the hook (i.e. "j>=X"). Thank you :)

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: liked it, went fishing ;)

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Nice puzzle, simple solution, reasonably obvious pattern.

It's good, but could be made a bit harder if you want.
 - include fish that move to the left A=< (maybe up as well), choose the closest.
 - or include fish with different lengths and/or different middle cells so that we have to search for the whole fish not just the uppercase character.
 - or if >=(upper char) is a valid fish, include fish that are not valid and must be ignored.
or I'll just approve because it's fine as is.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement.

Cases
* Consider adding a case where the area to the left of the bait is filled with non-space characters (more than two fish and more than two "o"s [bubbles?], including consecutive fish and consecutive "o"s).

* Current distribution of cases:
  - 2 pairs: bait directly below the water's surface
  - 5 pairs: bait at the bottom
  - 3 pairs: bait in the middle
  As you add more cases, please aim for a more balanced distribution across these three positions. It's not necessary to modify the existing cases.

Thanks.

Thank you for reviewing my puzzle.
It's a work in progress. Reworked almost everything. There's is a case for each possible height of the bait and each pair has a different configuration of what is to the left and right of the bait. (Yes, "o"s are bubbly bubbles :) )

Hmm, I like your ideas a lot!
I can't believe I didn't think of making fishes with different size :P
I was editing this one to put variable length fishes but doing so would require a whole refactor of the cases to cover more scenarios.
But you gave me ideas for new puzzles. I definitely pretend to make another one using your ideas!

Pair 2 & 8 had fish->bubble->hook->bubble so I changed Pair 2 to be fish->bubble->hook->fish

I changed Pair 5 so one fish is closer to a line

Huh...
The constraints are empty because it's a Reverse mode only contribution. No one ever raised this issue before AFAIK.

And stating all these constraints would affect the review, giving reviewers too much hints for solving the puzzle.

Also, players will not see the constraints or the statement at all. So it's basically useless for players to have a constraints section. That's why I left it empty.

Also, note that my solution doesn't use Regex or clever math. That's because I'm trying to make a "naive" solution, trying to simulate how a beginner would do it. I think simple tasks are harder when you have a 15 minutes timer :P

There's an extra line in the input of Validator 7.

Please add a write statement to the stub. 😉

Thanks.

Oh my goshhh why am I always forgetting the write statement.

I fixed the extra line.

Is there anything else I can improve? Thank you for always helping us. You're an incredible person :)

Thank you for your kind words 😊

The only thing I can think of is to add a case pair in which the entire water is filled with fish and bubbles (i.e. no space characters below the surface).
Can I replace every space in Pair 9 with bubbles? Pair 9 is similar to Pair 7, and Pair 6 already cover the scenario where fishes are close together.
Done. I changed the status to ready. Thanks!
